summary: Chariclo was the nymph wife of the centaur Chiron on Mount Pelion. She appears beside Chiron when the Argonauts depart and, in Ovid, is the mother of the prophetess Ocyrhoe. She is distinct from the Theban Chariclo, mother of Tiresias.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Apollonius shows Chiron's wife carrying the infant Achilles when the Argonauts sail. Ovid names her Chariclo and makes her mother of Ocyrhoe, who inherited prophetic frenzy from her centaur father.
